name: What happens after I approve a residential repair estimate?

mainEntity.name: What happens after I approve a residential repair estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Once you approve a residential repair estimate from City Dweller, LLC, we will finalize the project contract, including payment schedules and agreed-upon timelines. We then proceed with scheduling the work, ordering necessary materials, and coordinating our team and any subcontractors. Our project manager will keep you informed throughout the process, ensuring a smooth transition from estimate approval to project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: After approval, we finalize the contract, schedule work, order materials, and coordinate our team. Our project manager will keep you updated.
